subject: Latent Difference Score Model with two groups

messages.author: 76d79d6b763c09e8
messages.subject: Latent Difference Score Model with two groups
parts:
Hi 

I would like to run a LDSM with two groups in lavaan. I have two latent variables (T1 and T2) with 3 indicators each. I want to force the model to measurement invariance with fixed loadings and fixed means of the latent variables across groups and time points. The picture depicts the model (for one group) I want to run (see Schmiedek, Lövdén, Lindenberger, 2010).


I'm very new to R in general and also lavaan, so I'm not sure if my code is correct. Has anyone experience with this kind of models? I would very much appreciate input or corrections of my code! Thank you very much in advance!
Sabrina

model<-'
## define latent variables
   T1 =~ cs.0 + a*binding.0 + b*updating.0
   T2 =~ cs.1 + a*binding.1 + b*updating.1

## residuals
   cs.0 ~~ cs.0
   binding.0 ~~ binding.0
   updating.0 ~~ updating.0
   cs.1 ~~ cs.1
   binding.1 ~~ binding.1
   updating.1 ~~ updating.1

## residual correlations
   cs.1 ~~ cs.0
   binding.1 ~~ binding.0
   updating.1 ~~ updating.0

## free latent variances and covariances
    LC ~~ var.LC*LC
    T1 ~~ var.T1*T1
    T1 ~~ eta*LC

## define latent difference score (fix loading to 1)
    LC =~ 1*T2
## fix latent regression to 1 to define latent difference score
    T1 ~ 1*T2
## fix FT2 variance to zero to define latent difference score
    T2 ~~ 0*T2
## no correlations between FT2 and other latent variables 
    LC + T1 ~~ 0*T2

! means
  T1 ~~ eta*LC
  LC ~ beta*1
  T1 ~ alpha*1
'

result<-lavaan(model, data=data, fixed.x=FALSE, missing="FIML", meanstructure = TRUE, group = "group", group.equal = c("loadings", "means", "residual.covariances"), estimator = "MLR");
summary(result, fit.measures=TRUE);

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Latent Difference Score Model with two groups
parts:
On 11/18/2015 10:00 AM, S.G. wrote:
> model<-'
> ## define latent variables
> T1 =~ cs.0 + a*binding.0 + b*updating.0
> T2 =~ cs.1 + a*binding.1 + b*updating.1

A late reply, but hopefully it may still be useful:

Given that you are using the lavaan() function, you need to manually fix
the first factor loadings to 1.0:

T1 =~ 1*cs.0 + a*binding.0 + b*updating.0
T2 =~ 1*cs.1 + a*binding.1 + b*updating.1

> ## fix latent regression to 1 to define latent difference score
> T1 ~ 1*T2

Is it not the other way around?

T2 ~ 1*T1
This is not a mean! (and was already defined)

> LC ~ beta*1
> T1 ~ alpha*1
>
> result<-lavaan(model, data=data, fixed.x=FALSE, missing="FIML",
> meanstructure = TRUE, group = "group", group.equal = c("loadings",
> "means", "residual.covariances"), estimator = "MLR");

I would also recommend to use labels for each group, instead of using
the group.equal= argument. It gives more clarity (and flexibility). For
example, the first two lines would become:

T1 =~ 1*cs.0 + c(a1,a2)*binding.0 + c(b1,b2)*updating.0
T2 =~ 1*cs.1 + c(a1,a2)*binding.1 + c(b1,b2)*updating.1

OR, if you wish to constrain the factor loadings to be equal across
groups, you write

T1 =~ 1*cs.0 + c(a1,a1)*binding.0 + c(b1,b1)*updating.0
T2 =~ 1*cs.1 + c(a1,a1)*binding.1 + c(b1,b1)*updating.1

Yves.
